en.headline: Asia+ Festival opens with cross-border music fusion concert
en.dek: The fourth edition begins tonight at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre with TRI-ART! ON, pairing local artists and bands from Mongolia, Korea and Thailand.
body: The Asia+ Festival 2026 opens on Wednesday evening with a cross-border music concert that brings together Hong Kong musicians and visiting bands from Mongolia, South Korea and Thailand at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre.

Presented by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the fourth edition of the festival runs from September to November and features more than 100 performances and activities involving artists from over 30 countries and regions, including six first-time participants.

The opening programme, titled TRI-ART! ON, is led by Hong Kong producer Carl Wong together with local musicians including drummer Jun Kung, guitarist Jason Kui, vocalist Jan Curious, multi-instrumentalist Danny Yau and keyboardist Frankie Yip. They share the stage with Mongolian heavy-metal band Uuhai, making its Hong Kong debut, Korean rock band KARDI and Thai indie-pop group KIKI.

Tickets for the two nights of the concert on 23 and 24 September range from HK$380 to HK$720 and remain available through URBTIX. The festival continues through late November with dance, theatre, outdoor cultural performances and other programmes drawing on traditional and contemporary forms from across Asia and Belt and Road regions.

zh.headline: 亞藝無疆開幕音樂會今晚上演 港樂人聯同蒙韓泰樂隊跨界合作
zh.dek: 第四屆亞藝無疆今晚於香港文化中心揭幕，開幕節目「三角演義」由本地音樂人聯同蒙古、韓國及泰國樂隊同台演出。
body: 第四屆「亞藝無疆」藝術節今晚於香港文化中心大劇院揭幕，開幕音樂會「三角演義」由本地音樂人與來自蒙古、韓國及泰國的樂隊同台演出，以跨界音樂揭開為期約兩個半月的文化盛事。
藝術節由文化體育及旅遊局主辦、康樂及文化事務署籌辦，今年吸引逾30個國家及地區的藝術家參與，當中六個屬首次加入。節目超過100項，涵蓋音樂、舞蹈、戲劇及戶外民族表演等。
開幕音樂會由本地監製王雙駿率領，聯同鼓手恭碩良、結他手瞿俊僖、主音阿水、多種弦樂器手Danny Yau及鍵盤手葉彥廷等本地樂手，與蒙古重金屬樂隊Uuhai（首次訪港）、韓國搖滾樂隊KARDI及泰國獨立流行組合KIKI合作，融合草原馬頭琴、韓國玄琴與熱帶節奏。
音樂會於9月23及24日晚上演，票價由380元至720元，仍可透過城市售票網購票。藝術節將持續至11月底，繼續呈獻亞洲及一帶一路地區的傳統與當代藝術交流。
